description: Send the buyer's purchase order for an issued offer or a placed order: number, revision, lines, total, currency and payment terms. It is matched against the accepted terms; differences are recorded and shown in inspect_offer thread.purchasing as exceptions, never silently accepted. A changed purchase order is the same number with a higher revision. This does not accept the offer and pays nothing.

id.description: The request or offer id from your receipt or customer link

name.description: Name of the person making this for the buyer

buyer_vendor_id.description: The seller's vendor id in the buyer's system

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the purchase order document, if there is one

invoice_route.description: Where invoices go: a portal URL, email or API

revision.description: 1 unless this replaces an earlier revision

terms_sha256.description: Exact terms_sha256 from inspect_offer; the act is refused if the terms have changed since

token.description: Private token from your receipt or customer link; keep it for later visits

name: submit_purchase_order
title: Send a purchase order
